newsitem.title: USA: LaserSight, IBM reach agreement on terms of pact.
newsitem.headline: LaserSight, IBM reach agreement on terms of pact.

text.p: LaserSight Inc said Friday it has successfully negotiated terms of an agreement to purchase from International Business Machines Corp certain patents related to ultraviolet light ophthalmic products and services.
The agreement, announced on February 20, 1997, provided for LaserSight to place a $1 million deposit of LaserSight stock into escrow. Other terms were not disclosed.
The agreement is expected to be signed March 10, 1997.
LaserSight makes and sells lasers for vision care, provides managed vision care administration, manages ophthalmic practices and offers health and vision care consulting services.
